meta.title: MNT — The operating system for organisations
meta.description: MNT (منظمتي): projects, grants, budgets and expenses in one transparent, auditable platform.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: {count, plural, one {One person works} other {# people work}} in the organisation, each with a clear role.
team.subtitleLoading: Who works in the organisation, and what each person does.
team.chainBody: Every expense goes through three different people before it counts. Nobody can approve an expense they submitted.

about.admin: Runs the organisation on the platform: team, roles and settings.
about.director: Sees everything in the organisation and gives final approval on expenses.
about.accountant: Checks every expense and its invoice before it reaches the director.
about.project_coordinator: Follows activities in the field and submits expenses with their invoices.
about.hr_officer: Manages staff files and prepares payroll every month.
about.logistician: Handles purchasing and transport, and submits their expenses.
about.donor_viewer: Donor representative: views projects without changing anything.
